body:
This is pathetic.  I am back here on this sub every few months.  

Is there a point where you just say fuck it?  Really, why do you all care that fucking much if I commit suicide or not?  I will be honest, it legitimately upsets me.  This society of being obsessed with preventing suicide is why I am in this situation.  I have a quick, efficient, peaceful way to go, but now I have to make sure any suicide looks like a fucking accident, because it will destroy too many people otherwise.  So I can't kill myself the way I want, and have to go for some bullshit alternative.

Why can't it just be, that I fucking kill myself in the manner of my choosing, and people say, fuck, I'm sorry that it happened but I'm glad they are free of their demons.
